description_zh_TW: 為電商素材 App 預先製作的 AI 示範商品照與參考圖延伸素材。使用者已授權自製示範商品與延伸圖。
provenance_boundary_zh_TW: 這些圖由 Codex 內建 imagegen 工具在開發期間產生，不是 App 執行期間呼叫 Google Vertex AI 或 OpenAI API 的結果。模型名稱未由工具回傳，因此記為未知。
sample_disclaimer_zh_TW: MORI、SORA 與 PLAIN 是此示範使用的虛構產品名稱，不代表真實商品、商標權利、成分或功效。

records.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: a source product photo for an ecommerce image-generation demo. Create one square 1:1 photorealistic studio product photograph, not a collage. Subject: one imaginary premium roasted tea canister, cylindrical metal tin with a matching lid, matte soft sage-green body, a neat cream vertical paper label on the front. On the label, render exactly two simple lines: "MORI" and "ROASTED TEA". Nothing else printed. Neutral warm off-white seamless background and surface, gentle realistic contact shadow. The closed tin stands upright at a subtle three-quarter angle, the label legible, centered and fully visible with ample margin, product occupies roughly 65% of image height. Soft diffused window-quality light, elegant natural materials, accurate metal edges and paper texture, crisp commercial photography, 85mm lens character. No loose tea, no cup, no hands, no decoration, no other objects, no advertising overlay, no watermark, no health claims. This is an imaginary demonstration product, no actual brand logos.
